scenes.title: £105 vs £80 a night: 2-bed apartment vs house Airbnb in Jamaica
scenes.vo: A hundred and five pounds a night for a two-bed apartment Airbnb in Jamaica. A two-bed house? About eighty.

scenes.desc: Typical asking price, 2-bed house in Jamaica (apartment: £225k)
scenes.vo: But the house is typically listed at around a hundred and twenty-three thousand pounds. The apartment, about two hundred and twenty-five thousand.
In US dollars, that's roughly a hundred and sixty-four thousand, against three hundred and one thousand.

scenes.desc: Gross Airbnb yield, 2-bed house, at 60% occupancy (apartment: 10%)
scenes.vo: At sixty percent occupancy, the house grosses about fourteen percent of its price a year. The apartment, about ten.
That's before costs, and location still decides it. Check the bookings near the exact place you're buying.
